newsitem.title: UK: Argentina raises 750 mln marks via two Eurobonds.
newsitem.headline: Argentina raises 750 mln marks via two Eurobonds.

text.p: Argentina has launched two 375 million mark callable Eurobonds with seven- and 20-year maturities, lead manager CSFB-Effectenbank said on Tuesday.

A nine percent seven-year offering, reoffered at 99.75, is callable at par after five years. A 12 percent 20-year offering, also reoffered at 99.75, is callable at par on the coupon dates in 2006 and 2011.
